summary: @cswordpress We know that SemPress is compatible with Gutenberg and 5.0, 2016-IndieWeb as well. The post-kind plugin is 5.0 compatible but does not work with Gutenberg. You have to use the classic editor. #IndieWeb
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@cswordpress We know that SemPress is compatible with Gutenberg and 5.0, 2016-IndieWeb as well.

The post-kind plugin is 5.0 compatible but does not work with Gutenberg. You have to use the classic editor. #IndieWeb
